title: Research: faithful S3 output transport saves 120 primitives (no new kappa)
body:
Fixed children that permute a six-row workspace can replace repeated workspace restoration with physical operations on a faithful two-dimensional S3 output. The complete seed-58 dirty echo uses **404 ADD/NEG instructions instead of 524**, including both source-copy passes, every child and inverse, and final restoration. The boundary costs **36 instead of 96**.

**Status: scoped recursive-interface research construction; no new kappa or selected-supplier adoption.**

The contribution is entirely in `research/s3-standard-output-transport/`. It adds the integer intertwiner characterization, a chronological six-state recurrence, complete recursive words and a separate permutation/difference-coordinate oracle. A 294-inequality primal/dual certificate proves that 36 is the exact boundary minimum in the declared uniform macro interface; the emitted path attains it.

This extends Ross Richardson's PR #1287 cyclic output frames and Sagar Thakrar's PR #1227 sign frames. Concurrent Discussion #1381 studies a one-dimensional S3 sign-character quotient; this package instead preserves the full noncommuting group action in two output coordinates. General output transport and dirty-echo cancellation retain predecessor credit. No predecessor verifier is imported.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/s3-standard-output-transport
```

Expected: `PASS_S3_STANDARD_OUTPUT boundary=36_vs_96 echo=404_vs_524 saved=120 controls=11 no_new_kappa`, five passing package tests, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Validation includes 378,504 unaligned schedules plus 186,624 cut-policy schedules; 24 recursive cases and 816 forward/inverse basis columns; array lifts; 11 semantic controls; and source/certificate/macro corruption and read-only relocation. The registered Python 3.12.13 replay, optimized Python 3.14.6 replay, source pins and selected-record integrity checks pass. The patch applies to refreshed main `e6f9716621f4e01fc190617934cdfaf072bd976f`.

The fixed-child restriction matters: opening the toy matrix leaves permits cheaper direct evaluation. No actual selected supplier exposing this interface has been identified. The forward prefix row-L1 bound grows **65 to 114**. This does not establish a runtime gain, a contracting input-size recurrence, fixed-precision/physical-tape admission or a full multiplication theorem. Hosted CI and independent human review are separate.

Research base: `410026dc5513b87db92ae98571d1d5984c69a983`; OS assignment seed **58**, recursive interfaces. Exact predecessor pins, overlap coverage and limitations are in `PREDECESSORS.json` and `OVERLAP.json`. [Sprint claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1467).

Prepared by **Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in derivation, both implementations, verification and prose. The separate implementations were written in the same AI-assisted session. New work is Apache-2.0, with predecessor attribution and reference bytes retained.
